svg.aria-label: Sales rehearsal as a live call: your pitch, “12-minute workouts at home, try 7 days free”, gets the buyer’s trust objection, “will it charge me after day 7?”. An arguing rebuttal, “it’s worth it, our members love it”, backfires and the buyer moves from maybe to no. The report’s fix from the README’s Fitloop run appears: show the exact charge after day 7, the cancel steps and the local price instead of arguing, and the call is rehearsed again. Call lines are illustrative.

svg.text: Your pitch goes to every buyer. They object, your rebuttal answers, they decide again.

g.text: “12-minute workouts at home. Try 7 days free.”
“It’s worth it, our members love it.”
“After day 7: the exact charge, the cancel steps, your local price.”
In the README’s Fitloop run the pitch
rebuttals, about a fifth of the people
Show the exact charge after day 7,
the cancel steps and the local price
Then rehearse again with the new rebuttal.

svg.text: Result and fix from the README's 3,000-person run; the call lines are illustrative.
